title: Auritus
description:
Open-source (MIT) just-in-time TTS embed for the web: drop-in player, client-side generator, AWS CDK backend with DynamoDB mutex, local GPU worker race, and AWS Batch fallback. TTS backends: Higgs + Qwen 3 (pluggable). Operator auth: Cognito + Google. Browser auth: site keys. Site: aurit.us on Amplify. CLI on PyPI via semantic-release.

Architect plans and reviews; coding agents implement Stories with step-by-step briefs. Behavior-driven (Gherkin in features/). Git Flow: develop integrates, main releases.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Stopping point 13 Sep 2026. Public examples on https://aurit.us play Kokoro and Qwen with visible Play chrome and generated speech. Local workers and AWS Batch both generate Kokoro and Qwen. M0–M6, M5, and M-TTS-1/2 are closed with proof. Still open: M7 (PyPI last), M-TTS-3 extra backends, and in-progress logo lockup 083e46.

right_now_summary: Auritus demos and AWS/local TTS work; PyPI publishing, extra backends, and the logo lockup remain.
